pages.title: A Lost Legacy
pages.text: This progression revolves around ruins, runes, and ancient books. Prepare $(item)Spirit Glasses$() and an empty $(item)Reflection Orb$() before searching for an underground stele grotto.$(br2)Only the glasses reveal hidden runes and allow the orb to work on a stele.

pages.title: Complete Route
pages.text: $(li)Gather runes from a stele$(li)Extract and store them in a Rune Table$(li)Find Torn Pages in ruin chests$(li)Analyze them into an Ancient Book$(li)Spend runes to rotate its array$(li)Connect the network and claim a random manual

pages.title: Two Resources
pages.text: Deciphering needs two separate resources:$(br2)$(bold)Torn Pages$() power Ancient Book production, while $(bold)runes$() pay for rotations on its array.$(br2)Gathering only one cannot complete the progression, so collect both while exploring.
